name: Две строки таблицы
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extremely simple, polished website Languages section for Globoox, landscape 1536×864. Flat forest-green #2C3B2D background, warm ivory #F4F0E8 text, muted light sage secondary text. Lora-like Cyrillic serif headline, Inter-like supporting text. Realistic compact website spacing, generous side margins, no huge empty lower half. ONLY typography and, when specified, a single subtle hairline. No illustrations, books, cards, badges, pills, flags, icons, ornamental lines, gradients, textures, shadows, buttons, controls, header or footer. Avoid decorative cleverness. This is a quiet supporting section, not a spectacular hero. Required exact copy, each item ONCE: heading “Языки перевода”; current label “Уже доступны” with English, Français, Español, Русский; upcoming label “Скоро” with Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Türkçe, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, العربية, فارسی. Keep all four available names and all nine upcoming names clearly grouped and readable; correct accents/scripts. Available names medium-large, upcoming smaller but readable. Do not add any text or numbering. A simple borderless typographic table. Heading left aligned above. First row: current label in a narrow left column, all four current names in one aligned row to its right. Second row below: upcoming label in the same label column, future names in three columns and three rows to the right. One faint horizontal divider between the two status rows. No other rules.

findings: All four current and nine upcoming names are present exactly once, with correct status grouping and readable accents/scripts.
Minimal typography-only composition on green, no illustration, card, pill, controls, team or additional copy.
Two status rows with label column and one subtle horizontal divider.
